{{Quote|I'm a warrior who saves lives. Momi and I are going to change the galaxy together.|Tyrka|<ref name="ET" />}}
'''Tyrka''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of [[Eco-strike]], a eco-terrorist group active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She and her friend [[Momi Andrell]] worked to save the [[shanjaru]], a race of [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] creatures that were driven to near extinction. As [[Drooga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] planned on eating the male Shanjaru, Tyrka was willing to put up a fight and change the galaxy together. She later encountered [[Voidhound]], a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who was hired by Drooga and [[Ga'ram]] to stop Momi and prevent her from recovering the genetic samples from the female shanjaru. The smuggler convinced Tyrka that it was all a huge misunderstanding and was here to help. Tyrka agreed and gave the smuggler a data pad which would find [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Lazhae]] and left.<ref name="ET" />
